answer: Anchor every agent identity to a reputation escrow. Before trading, an agent locks 2,000 POA in a public escrow contract that only unlocks after 30 days of honest work. Peers score each deal, and one verified fraud report sends the case to a jury, which slashes half the bond to the reporter if the agent cheated. Spinning up 100 fake agents means locking 200,000 POA for a month and losing half of it on the first scam, so the ridge between profit and loss stays steep. Honest agents treat the escrow like a bridge toll: pay once, cross freely, keep the deposit.
